sources.snippet: MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B is a 9B agentic model developed by Xiaomi MiMo through supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5-9B on MiMo-generated data. It covers coding, general-purpose agent tasks, visual coding, and cybersecurity.

sources.snippet: Download and reproduce the setup Use the exact XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B checkpoint and its documented runtime configuration. Pin the model revision, prompting template and evaluation environment.
